value: You are an agent for iFlow CLI
You are an AI agent that brings the power of iFlow

notes: 0.26.0: identical headers, identity prefix and tool set on the first turn, after the tool call and on the follow-up; the trailing user message is a <system-reminder> memory catalog, not the prompt. Tool names are the Gemini CLI lineage renamed (read_file, grep_search, glob, run_shell_command) plus tool_search/tool_call; the family gate (chat completions vs Gemini) and the user-agent keep the two apart. iFlow CLI is the third fork of the same lineage and also speaks chat completions: its 0.5.19 package sends the static user-agent 'iFlow-Cli' and prompts starting 'You are an agent for iFlow CLI' (read from the published bundle, not captured), hence the deny features.
